name: Card Construct VII
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 7, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7

DESCRIPTION

You toss out a card and it grows in size turning into a CR 10 animated card, or 1d3 CR 8 animated cards. You can choose to summon 1d3 card swarms instead.
